finding: There is no official source for a betting line, an opening number, a closing number, a price or a bet limit. NFL.com publishes scores, schedules, injuries and rules; it publishes no market price. The price-snapshot store therefore holds two classes of number: the model line this project originates itself (class B) and a community mirror of the market's line (class C). The opening-line archive in the pinned upstream covers the spread and the total for the 2021 season only and carries no price at all, so the opening number is blank for every other game and for the moneyline everywhere.
consequence: Every return computed in this repository is class D and is published as labelled research data with its n, never as a finding. Gate G1 fails closed for all 18 strategies and no strategy can reach a live tier.
next_action: Capture an authenticated pre-kickoff quote with its timestamp, its operator and its limits, prospectively, as proposal S03 / MS-003 on the review queue describes. No historical price can be made official after the fact.
